meaning.en: The vast, varied world with all its kinds of people and things.
meaning.zh: 原为佛教用语，现泛指广阔而丰富多彩的世界。

examples.zh: 大千世界，无奇不有。
examples.en: In this vast world, anything can happen.

examples.zh: 他想出去看看大千世界。
examples.en: He wants to go out and see the wide world.

examples.zh: 大千世界里什么人都有。
examples.en: In the big wide world, you find all kinds of people.

usage.en: Often as a subject or object; common in 大千世界，无奇不有.

meaning.en: To act in a way that goes against the trend of the times or common sense.
meaning.zh: 做事违背时代潮流或常理，多指做坏事。

examples.zh: 这个独裁者倒行逆施，最终众叛亲离。
examples.en: The dictator acted perversely and was finally abandoned by all.

examples.zh: 他们倒行逆施，必然遭到人民唾弃。
examples.en: Their perverse policies are bound to be rejected by the people.

story.en: Wu Zixu, avenging himself on Chu, said: 'My day is nearly over and the road is long, so I act backwards and against the grain' (吾日莫途远，吾故倒行而逆施之).
story.zh: 《史记》：“吾日莫途远，吾故倒行而逆施之。”

meaning.en: A statement that gives only one party's account.
meaning.zh: 只有一方面的说法，不一定可信。

examples.zh: 不能只听他的一面之词。
examples.en: We can't just listen to his side of the story.

examples.zh: 这只是原告的一面之词。
examples.en: This is only the plaintiff's version.

usage.zh: 多作宾语，含不可全信之意。

meaning.en: Flawless and tight, leaving no loophole.
meaning.zh: 一滴水也不漏，比喻说话做事周密严谨，没有漏洞。

examples.zh: 他的发言滴水不漏。
examples.en: His speech was watertight.

examples.zh: 这个计划安排得滴水不漏。
examples.en: The plan is laid out without a single gap.

examples.zh: 警方把现场守得滴水不漏。
examples.en: The police sealed the scene tight.

meaning.en: Either this or that, with no middle ground.
meaning.zh: 不是这个就是那个，没有中间状态。

examples.zh: 世界并不是非此即彼的。
examples.en: The world isn't either-or.

examples.zh: 看问题不能非此即彼。
examples.en: We shouldn't see problems in black and white.

usage.en: Attributive or predicate; often with 不能/不是.

meaning.en: Everyone comes out to watch, leaving the streets empty.
meaning.zh: 家家户户的人都从巷子里出来了，形容庆祝、欢迎等盛况。

equivalents: streets deserted as everyone turns out

examples.zh: 球队凯旋，全城万人空巷。
examples.en: The team returned in triumph and the whole city turned out.

examples.zh: 这场演出万人空巷，一票难求。
examples.en: The show drew crowds from everywhere; tickets were impossible to get.

meaning.en: To condemn someone or something entirely because of one fault.
meaning.zh: 比喻因为一点错误就把人或事物完全否定。

examples.zh: 别因为一次失败就把他一棍子打死。
examples.en: Don't write him off because of one failure.

examples.zh: 对犯错的年轻人不能一棍子打死。
examples.en: We shouldn't condemn young people outright for their mistakes.

meaning.en: Outstanding, far above the ordinary.
meaning.zh: 不同于一般的声响，形容事物不平凡，很出色。

equivalents: in a class of its own

examples.zh: 他的演奏不同凡响。
examples.en: His playing was out of the ordinary.

examples.zh: 这座建筑设计得不同凡响。
examples.en: The building's design is exceptional.

natural: a matter of life and death

meaning.en: Vitally important, bearing on life and death.
meaning.zh: 关系到生存或死亡，形容事情极其重要。

equivalents: a matter of life and death

examples.zh: 这是一个生死攸关的时刻。
examples.en: This is a life-or-death moment.

examples.zh: 水源问题对村民来说生死攸关。
examples.en: Water is a matter of life and death for the villagers.

meaning.en: So tempting that one's mouth waters.
meaning.zh: 馋得口水都要流下来，形容非常贪馋或羡慕。

examples.zh: 桌上的烤鸭让人垂涎欲滴。
examples.en: The roast duck on the table made my mouth water.

examples.zh: 他对这个职位垂涎欲滴。
examples.en: He's drooling over that position.

usage.en: Predicate or complement; can be figurative covetousness.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、补语，也可比喻贪羡。

meaning.en: To extend something to a wider scope.
meaning.zh: 把某种事物或道理的应用范围扩大。

examples.zh: 这种方法试点成功后，可以推而广之。
examples.en: Once the pilot succeeds, the method can be extended more widely.

examples.zh: 推而广之，整个行业都面临同样的问题。
examples.en: By extension, the whole industry faces the same problem.

meaning.en: To walk right into a trap.
meaning.zh: 自己投进捕鸟的网，比喻自己送上门去陷入圈套。

examples.zh: 他深夜独自前往，无异于自投罗网。
examples.en: Going alone at night was walking into the trap.

examples.zh: 小偷回到现场，结果自投罗网。
examples.en: The thief returned to the scene and walked into the trap.

meaning.en: Noble conduct and unblemished integrity.
meaning.zh: 品格高尚，节操坚贞。

examples.zh: 他一生清廉，高风亮节，令人敬佩。
examples.en: Honest all his life, with lofty integrity, he is deeply admired.

examples.zh: 老校长的高风亮节感动了全校师生。
examples.en: The old principal's noble character moved the whole school.

usage.en: Often as object or attributive; praise.

meaning.en: A single promise worth a thousand pieces of gold; very trustworthy.
meaning.zh: 一句承诺就值千金，形容说话算数，极讲信用。

examples.zh: 他向来一诺千金，从不食言。
examples.en: He's a man of his word and never goes back on it.

examples.zh: 做生意要一诺千金。
examples.en: In business you must keep your word.

story.en: A saying about Ji Bu: 'Better to have a promise from Ji Bu than a hundred catties of gold' (得黄金百斤，不如得季布一诺).
story.zh: 《史记》：“得黄金百斤，不如得季布一诺。”

meaning.en: To do things one's own way, ignoring others.
meaning.zh: 不接受别人意见，按自己认为对的去做。

examples.zh: 各部门自行其是，缺乏协调。
examples.en: Departments each go their own way, with no coordination.

examples.zh: 他总是自行其是，不听劝告。
examples.en: He always does as he pleases and ignores advice.

meaning.en: Weighed down by many worries.
meaning.zh: 心里有很多顾忌和担忧。

examples.zh: 对这次投资，他顾虑重重。
examples.en: He's full of misgivings about this investment.

examples.zh: 她顾虑重重，迟迟不敢开口。
examples.en: Burdened with worries, she dared not speak up.

meaning.en: Bright windows and clean tables; a neat, tidy room.
meaning.zh: 窗户明亮，桌子干净，形容房间整洁明亮。

examples.zh: 教室里窗明几净，让人心情舒畅。
examples.en: The classroom is bright and spotless, which lifts the mood.

examples.zh: 老太太把家里收拾得窗明几净。
examples.en: The old lady keeps her home spick and span.

meaning.en: To increase income and reduce expenditure.
meaning.zh: 开辟财源，节约开支。

examples.zh: 公司面临困难，必须开源节流。
examples.en: The company is in difficulty and must raise income and cut costs.

examples.zh: 家庭理财要开源节流。
examples.en: Household finance means earning more and spending less.

story.en: Xunzi on enriching the state: 'Hold back the tax rate and ease the people... open the sources and economise the flow' (节其流，开其源).
story.zh: 《荀子·富国》：“故明主必将先治其国，……节其流，开其源，而时斟酌焉。”

meaning.en: To sigh over and over out of sadness or worry.
meaning.zh: 因伤感、烦闷或痛苦而发出叹息声。

examples.zh: 别整天唉声叹气，想想办法吧。
examples.en: Stop sighing all day and think of a solution.

examples.zh: 他看着账单直唉声叹气。
examples.en: He sighed over and over at the bills.

antonyms: 黄连树下弹琴——苦中作乐

meaning.en: To base spending on income.
meaning.zh: 根据收入的多少来决定开支的限度。

equivalents: cut one's coat according to one's cloth

examples.zh: 年轻人花钱要量入为出。
examples.en: Young people should live within their means.

examples.zh: 政府预算要量入为出。
examples.en: Government budgets should be set according to revenue.

story.en: Liji, on state finance: 'Measure income in order to set expenditure' (量入以为出).
story.zh: 《礼记·王制》：“用地小大，视年之丰耗。以三十年之通制国用，量入以为出。”

antonyms: 打肿脸充胖子——死要面子活受罪

meaning.en: To set prices according to the market.
meaning.zh: 价格随着市场行情的变化而变动。

examples.zh: 蔬菜价格随行就市。
examples.en: Vegetable prices follow the market.

examples.zh: 房租将随行就市调整。
examples.en: Rents will be adjusted to the market rate.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、状语，经济用语。

meaning.en: To rise suddenly to great heights after a long quiet spell.
meaning.zh: 一飞就冲上高空，比喻平时默默无闻，一旦行动就取得惊人成就。

examples.zh: 这位新人一飞冲天，成了年度最佳。
examples.en: The newcomer shot to the top and became best of the year.

examples.zh: 他蛰伏多年，终于一飞冲天。
examples.en: After years lying low, he finally soared.

story.en: The jester Chunyu Kun asks King Wei of Qi, who had neglected government for three years, about a bird that neither flew nor sang: 'This bird, if it does not fly, flies up to heaven when it does; if it does not cry, astonishes everyone when it does.' The king took the hint and reformed.
story.zh: 《史记·滑稽列传》：淳于髡以大鸟为喻讽谏齐威王：“此鸟不飞则已，一飞冲天；不鸣则已，一鸣惊人。”威王醒悟，奋发图治。

meaning.en: To lose something important for the sake of a trifle.
meaning.zh: 为了小利而造成大的损失。

equivalents: lose the big for the small

examples.zh: 为省几块钱买劣质零件，这是因小失大。
examples.en: Buying shoddy parts to save a few yuan is penny wise, pound foolish.

examples.zh: 不要因小失大，耽误了正事。
examples.en: Don't lose sight of the big thing and delay the real work.

synonyms: 捉了虱子跑了牛——得不偿失
抓了芝麻丢西瓜——主次不分
整筐丢西瓜，满地拾芝麻——大处不算小处算
antonyms: 用小虾钓鲤鱼——吃小亏占大便宜

natural: fight and lose again and again

meaning.en: To lose every time one fights.
meaning.zh: 多次作战，多次失败；常与“屡败屡战”对比使用。

examples.zh: 球队屡战屡败，士气低落。
examples.en: The team lost match after match and morale sank.

examples.zh: 他屡战屡败，却从没放弃。
examples.en: He failed again and again, yet never gave up.

usage.en: Predicate. Contrast 屡败屡战 (fail but keep fighting).
usage.zh: 多作谓语；与“屡败屡战”对比。
